Class InterceptedMethod

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.inject.context.InterceptedMethod
public final class InterceptedMethod extends Object
An intercepted method's immutable call-site description: what the method is, and which annotations bind interceptors to it, outermost first. Generated proxies hold one static instance per intercepted method and bind(Context) it once per proxy instance.
